info.name: plan-by-weather
info.description: Start the service with `docker compose up --build`, then run these requests. Each GraphQL request has a description of what to look for in the answer. Tip: the same queries can be run in Apollo Sandbox at http://localhost:3000/graphql.

request.description: A city with no waves. The first call fetches from Open-Meteo: meta.source is OPEN_METEO. Surfing is reported unavailable.
Send request 1 again. Nothing is fetched: meta.source is DATABASE and fetchedAt is unchanged. The service refreshes a city at most every 6 hours.
A coastal city, so surfing gets a real score from wave height and swell period.
'Paris' alone means Paris, France. A countryCode picks another place.
Lists matching cities, best first, to find the right countryCode. Nothing is stored.
Expect errors[0].extensions.code = BAD_USER_INPUT, and no Open-Meteo call is made.
